parameters.content:
W07 Conversation agent. Owns POST /whatsapp (Cloud API webhook) for every inbound WhatsApp + status receipts.
Order (conversation/prompts/guardrail.md): verify X-Hub-Signature-256 -> 200 -> webhook_events idempotency (wamid) -> deterministic router (automation/lib/w07.mjs routeInbound: STOP->W15, CTWA/unknown->W03, taps->W04/W05/W08/W09/W10/W12/W28/W29/W35, broker numbers->W12/W29 (broker video, or audio while pre-live -> W23 sub-call, I-37d), ops numbers approve:/later: taps -> W32 decision sub-call (I-37e), handoff->paused; loop guard: a W03 hand-back (origin 'w03', via the sub-call trigger) is never routed to W03 again) -> store redacted inbound + verified_at (3.3) -> prefilter + redactForLLM -> intent-slot LLM (Haiku, prompts/intent-slot.md) -> decide() (logic.mjs) -> planActions (fixed lines, delegations, escalations incl. kind 'sensitive' stored as human_handoff/red per I-25, lead_activities 'lead_theme' rows per I-22) -> reply LLM only for actions that need words (prompts/reply.md) -> outputGate -> guardrail classifier on classifierInput() (I-27) -> toneCheck -> assemble -> send -> store outbound + conv_state.
Fails closed: classifier error/timeout = block -> fixed fallback (+ DEFER if the question was advice-shaped). Self-harm/bereavement: nothing automated is sent; Jonathan + KG alerted together, reminders paused.
Code nodes import repo modules from $env.REPO_DIR (same pattern as W30/W31); needs NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto,url,fs. Env: META_APP_SECRET, META_GRAPH_VERSION, PHONE_NUMBER_ID, META_SYSTEM_USER_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_MODEL_FAST, ANTHROPIC_MODEL_STRONG, TWILIO_*, OPS_WHATSAPP_JONATHAN, OPS_WHATSAPP_KG, DRY_RUN_SENDS. Synthetic tests: automation/tests/W07.test.mjs.
w07-alignment (I-35e): W04/W10 delegations carry the turn's fixed lines (delegate.lead_lines / delegate.body, one message; W07 sends nothing itself); outputGate runs before the classifier (trip = no classifier call); a classifier pass < 0.8 = block; reply facts = approved FAQ answer + KNOWN + booking time; greet/booking_status -> BOOKING_STATUS or W04; disclosed set only when a disclosure went out; W35 pulse line -> W35.

parameters.query:
-- delivery receipts: sent / delivered / read / failed (W06 disclosure evidence uses the same rows)
WITH c AS (
  UPDATE public.communications
     SET status = $2,
         delivered_at = CASE WHEN $2 IN ('delivered','read') THEN COALESCE(delivered_at, to_timestamp($3)) ELSE delivered_at END,
         read_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'read' THEN COALESCE(read_at, to_timestamp($3)) ELSE read_at END,
         failed_reason = CASE WHEN $2 = 'failed' THEN $4 ELSE failed_reason END,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE channel = 'whatsapp' AND external_id = $1 AND brand_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING lead_id)
UPDATE public.leads l
   SET wa_delivered_at = COALESCE(l.wa_delivered_at, to_timestamp($3)),
       disclosure_delivered_at = CASE WHEN l.disclosure_msg_id = $1 THEN COALESCE(l.disclosure_delivered_at, to_timestamp($3)) ELSE l.disclosure_delivered_at END
  FROM c
 WHERE l.id = c.lead_id AND $2 IN ('delivered','read');

INSERT INTO public.webhook_events (source, external_id, signature_ok, payload_hash)
VALUES ('whatsapp', $1, true, $2)
ON CONFLICT (source, external_id) DO UPDATE SET attempts = public.webhook_events.attempts + 1
RETURNING id, (xmax = 0) AS first_delivery;

parameters.query:
SELECT p.phone AS from_phone,
       l.id, l.first_name, l.last_name, l.phone, l.line_type, l.brand_id, l.broker_id, l.cycle_id, l.stage, l.conv_state,
       l.opted_out_at, l.language, l.origin, l.first_message_at, l.verified_at,
       l.age_band, l.budget_band, l.method_pref, l.email, l.call_number, l.best_time,
       b.contact_person, b.firm_name, b.whatsapp_number,
       a.id AS booking_id, a.appointment_date, a.ends_at, a.method, a.status AS booking_status, a.graph_event_id, a.reschedule_count,
       (SELECT max(c.created_at) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id AND c.direction = 'inbound') AS last_inbound_at,
       (SELECT bb.id FROM public.brokers bb WHERE bb.whatsapp_number = p.phone AND bb.brand_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS from_broker_id,
       (SELECT bb.brand_id FROM public.brokers bb WHERE bb.whatsapp_number = p.phone AND bb.brand_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS from_broker_brand_id,
       (SELECT bb.status FROM public.brokers bb WHERE bb.whatsapp_number = p.phone AND bb.brand_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS from_broker_status,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.suppression s WHERE s.mobile_hash = public.smc_hash_contact(p.phone)) AS suppressed
  FROM (SELECT $1::text AS phone) p
  LEFT JOIN public.leads l ON l.phone = p.phone AND l.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND l.duplicate_of IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = l.broker_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.id, x.appointment_date, x.ends_at, x.method, x.status, x.graph_event_id, x.reschedule_count
                       FROM public.appointments x
                      WHERE x.client_id = l.id AND x.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND x.status IN ('booked','confirmed')
                      ORDER BY x.appointment_date LIMIT 1) a ON true
 ORDER BY l.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 1;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO public.communications (brand_id, channel, direction, sender_type, sender_id, recipient_type, recipient_contact, content, status, external_id, lead_id, broker_id, author, workflow, redacted, metadata)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, 'whatsapp', 'inbound', $2, NULL, 'system', $3, $4, 'received', $5, $6::uuid, $7::uuid, $8, 'W07', $9::boolean, $10::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (channel, external_id) WHERE brand_id IS NOT NULL AND external_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id)
UPDATE public.leads
   SET verified_at = COALESCE(verified_at, CASE WHEN first_message_at IS NOT NULL AND now() <= first_message_at + interval '72 hours' THEN now() END),
       stage = CASE WHEN verified_at IS NULL AND stage IN ('new','disclosed') AND first_message_at IS NOT NULL AND now() <= first_message_at + interval '72 hours' THEN 'verified' ELSE stage END,
       last_contact_at = now()
 WHERE id = $6::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
RETURNING id, verified_at;

parameters.query:
WITH u AS (
  UPDATE public.leads
     SET call_number = COALESCE($2, call_number),
         call_number_line_type = COALESCE($3, call_number_line_type),
         alt_number = COALESCE($4, alt_number),
         alt_purpose = COALESCE($5, alt_purpose),
         best_time = COALESCE($6, best_time),
         conv_state = COALESCE(conv_state, '{}'::jsonb) || $7::jsonb,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = $1::uuid
  RETURNING id)
UPDATE public.appointments a
   SET call_number = $2, updated_at = now()
  FROM u
 WHERE a.client_id = u.id AND a.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND a.status IN ('booked','confirmed') AND $2 IS NOT NULL;
